row.title: The tenant-repos workflow holds no org credential; the tick Worker makes the repository
row.body: First live run after LAUNCH-PATH-1: ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN, LANE_PAT and the lane App secrets are all empty in tenant-repos.yml, so replication-ledger and second-tenant got no repository. TENANT-REPO-2: the workflow presents its OIDC token to the site worker and the tick Worker's admin and code Apps create the repository; a one-hour push token comes back only while the repository has no commit. A health-only seed now serves a public page at /. fullstack --live fetches a public repository at github.com so declared-and-never-made reads missing.
